clarity.notes: The responsive contract now has exactly four named modes—S, M, L, and XL—with one canonical owner in DESIGN.md and matching visual references.

hierarchy.notes: The baseline sheet compares the same four widths in a stable left-to-right sequence, making structural changes easy to scan without extra threshold cards.

typography.notes: PickFlick display-serif, product-sans, and metadata-mono roles remain intact while responsive labels use a concise S/M/L/XL vocabulary.

motion.notes: Existing motion contracts remain unchanged; the responsive reference itself stays deliberately static and uses reduced-motion-safe behavior.

brand.notes: Projector Noir styling remains consistent; gold is limited to breakpoint pivots and does not turn the documentation into a decorative dashboard.
